name: Naisho no Shinroshidou ~Sensei! Mou Gaman Dekinai!~
original_name: ナイショの進路指導 ～先生!もうガマンできないっ!～
source:
Going to a university, looking for a job... these girls are standing at the crossroads with a lot on their minds...
A novice teacher, through a strange twist of fate, is appointed as their guidance counselor and starts offering them a new kind of sexual guidance.
The students are at first bewildered and shy at his advances, but before long...

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033435.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
升学读大学，还是步入社会找工作……站在人生十字路口的少女们，心中满怀着迷茫与心事……
一名刚入职的新人男教师阴差阳错地受命担任她们的升学就业指导老师，竟开始为少女们提供起别开生面的“秘密性指导”。
起初，面对老师大胆越界的举动，女学生们还羞怯无措、不知如何是好，然而没过多久……

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033435.html]DLsite English[/url]]
